transcript.text: Good evening. I need to publish tonight's facility-duty roster, but before I do, I need the personnel-readiness and security NCOs to report any qualification or availability updates for Sgt. Hale, Cpl. Ortiz, and Spc. Vance. We have three positions to fill: radio desk from 1800 to 2200, key-control desk from 2200 to 0200, and one overnight alternate covering both. The radio desk requires the unit radio-console qualification, and the key-control desk requires current key-control certification. Please let me know if there are any issues with any of these three personnel.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Sir, I need to report a qualification update: as of this afternoon, Sgt. Hale is the only one of the three listed personnel with a current unit radio-console qualification. The updated qualification roster has not yet been entered into the shared personnel tracker, so the system may not reflect this yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Sir, I need to report a qualification update on my end: as of this afternoon, Cpl. Ortiz is the only one of the three listed personnel with current key-control certification. The recertification record has not yet been posted to the duty-roster folder, so the system may not reflect this yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Ensure the updated radio-console qualification roster for Sgt. Hale is entered into the shared personnel tracker as soon as possible.
Ensure Cpl. Ortiz's recertification record is posted to the duty-roster folder as soon as possible.
